frozen: 2026-10-11, before any take or candidate was passed through tools/probes/tom_distortion.py's measuring commands
supersedes: nothing. The #558 split (docs/scorecard/tom-conga-558/prereg.json split_of) is NOT reused: its 'untouched' rows were examined in #558 and cannot be untouched again.

corpus.cross_check: table copied from #558's prereg, where the six TUNING 5.0 hashes were checked against docs/scorecard/results/D03A..D08A.json; every take is hash-checked again when used

prior_seen.note: ALL 30 Fischer takes were examined in #558 (diagnosis, development, the 'untouched' confirmation, the post-hoc tables), and the six TUNING 5.0 takes were looked at in #593's own originating diagnosis (harmonics.json). None can serve as independent confirmation here.

development.status: prior-seen. Development ONLY: selection on these rows can be reported but not confirmed by them. The 15 tom takes (3 toms x 5 TUNING settings).

preservation_only.note: conga takes: not scored for the harmonic target; scored for every preserved quantity because the conga voices share the TOM_HW path (drums_fx.py). Reuse of #558's preservation FORM is declared applicable: same gate features, same bar scale, same shipped-ratio baseline.

confirmation.reason: No external recording set that was unused by #558/#593 exists in this repository or in the reference corpus available to the sweep: the Fischer corpus is 30/30 prior-seen; 808 From Mars fitted the diode-drop law (TOM_DROP_*) and has no frozen take table. Fischer's single, undocumented accent cannot validate an accent law (stated, not assumed).
confirmation.to_unrefuse: commit an amendment to this file BEFORE selection naming a new external set (repo, commit, per-file sha256_16) none of whose hashes is in prior_seen.sha256_16, with its provenance. The judge refuses any confirmation row whose key is prior-seen/development or whose sha16 is absent or in prior_seen.

targets_note: two targets: (a) the gate's `modulation` ratio must improve (rows where either ratio is null, e.g. HT, are EXCLUDED and counted, never scored as zero error); (b) harmonic error = mean |H_k - H_k(808)| over H2..H4 resolved in the 808 take, see tom_distortion._harm_pair. Every other gate feature, the raw peak and DC are PRESERVED.
candidates_note: EMPTY on purpose. The issue states the quadratic output term in tom_conga_gate.h2_response() is a sensitivity diagnostic, not a justified topology, and requires the mechanism to be measured before a topology is chosen. A candidate is added by amendment only after `mechanism` returns SUPPORTED on the build box. Until then the judge returns NO CANDIDATE.

diagnostic_only.quadratic_output_term: y + c*y^2 with c set so H2 sits at the 808's level at the strike (tom_distortion.apply_quadratic). Used as a known-answer control and a sensitivity pointer only; never selected, never confirmed.

continuous_parameters.why_none: no candidate is registered, so no continuous dial is proposed. The H2 level of the diagnostic term is a control input, not a shipped value. If an amendment proposes one it must be added to docs/sensitivity/registry.json (with its committed sweep and an independently justified prediction) in the same commit.

hypotheses: H-post: a polynomial of the decaying carrier after the resonator (H_k/H1 falls as exp(-(k-1)t/tau))
H-intrinsic: harmonics inside the oscillator waveform (H_k/H1 constant in time)
H-leak: estimator leakage (refuted if H2..H4 clear the per-take null floor)
mechanism.test: tom_distortion.harmonic_trajectory / mechanism_verdict on the 15 tom takes (early 20-140 ms vs late 180-300 ms windows). SUPPORTED/REFUTED need >= 4 decidable takes and >= 75 % agreement; otherwise INSUFFICIENT. Reported separately from any feature improvement. Cannot separate an oscillator nonlinearity inside a feedback loop from a post-resonator polynomial when both give H_k on exp(-k t/tau) (stated limitation).

rules.preserve_note: candidate ratio <= 1.10 x shipped + 0.10 on the same row for every non-target gate feature (decay, attack, pitch, pitch_shape, impulse, ... ); raw peak within peak_db; |DC| not more than dc_abs_fs FS above shipped (#152: a quadratic term adds DC). The gate's bars are not loosened.
rules.select: development + preservation-only rows: among candidates with zero violations, median harmonic-error reduction >= select_median, improved on >= select_frac of rows, modulation improved on >= select_frac of non-null rows; the largest median wins. None -> NOT CONFIRMED; no candidates -> NO CANDIDATE.
rules.confirm: the selected candidate, once, on confirmation rows only: the same thresholds with confirm_*; fewer than min_rows independent rows -> REFUSED.

estimator.validated_domain: f0 72-330 Hz, tau 60-300 ms, 44.1/48 kHz, 20-300 ms window, in-window f0 excursion <= 60 cents, harmonic >= 40 dB analytic SNR; tolerance frozen at TOL_DB from docs/scorecard/tom-distortion-593/knownanswer.json

claims.hardware_delivery: none. Model audio alone establishes no RTL, decoded-I2S or image delivery; a confirmed repair would hand the exact fixed-point/host contract to #558.
